candidatesScreened.route: River Acres Park to Cypress Bend Park
candidatesScreened.blocker: The City of New Braunfels currently identifies River Acres Park and Cypress Bend Park as public Guadalupe River access parks, publishes recreation flow bands, says access parks are open 6am-midnight subject to high-water/public-safety closures, and says there are no lifeguards. USGS 08168500 returned live Guadalupe River data at New Braunfels (394 cfs / 2.46 ft at 2026-08-13 18:15 CDT), inside the city open-recreation band. The candidate still failed because the city page is an access/rules page, not a source-backed point-to-point paddling trail with route mileage, selected put-in/take-out sequence, route-specific thresholds, camping/no-camping terms for this exact reach, and safety package beyond general city rules.

candidatesScreened.retryCondition: Do not retry unless a public manager publishes a non-lease public paddling endpoint pair and exact route package for the Trophy Trout reach, including camping/no-camping and safety terms.
